transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hi. Well, what brought me in is that I just can't keep my mind on one thing anymore. I'll be right in the middle of fixing a rendering bug for work, and... a Slack ping will go off, or I'll notice a certain color pattern on the screen, or even just hear a siren outside, and it just pulls me into a whole new idea. I end up completely sidetracked before I can even finish typing the line of code. It's making things really difficult.
When these distractions happen, like the Slack ping or noticing colors, do you find yourself intensely focusing on them for a while and losing track of everything else around you?

No, not really. It's... it's actually kind of the opposite. I don't get locked into the new thing or focus on it for a while. I just bounce off it. 

Like, I'll notice the color pattern and start thinking about that, but before I can even really dive into it, I'm already onto something else. I just... I can't stick to any of it long enough to intensely focus on it. Everything just keeps shifting.
Have you ever experienced periods where you felt unusually energetic, needed less sleep, or had racing thoughts that wouldn't slow down?

Yeah, actually, that's exactly what's been happening lately. I've just been... running on this constant current. I don't even really feel tired. I wake up and I'm already planning out new software features, thinking about exhibition layouts, figuring out press angles, making code changes... it's all just going at once. Sitting still just feels like I'm wasting the moment, you know? I just have to keep moving and doing things.
Do you find that your thoughts are often interrupted by things in your environment, like sounds or sights, even when you're trying to focus on something important?

Yeah, that's exactly what I was trying to explain when we first sat down. It's really the main reason I'm here—I just can't keep my mind on one thing anymore. 

Like I mentioned earlier, I'll be trying to focus on something important, like fixing a rendering bug for work, and... yeah, a Slack ping, or a siren outside, or just a color pattern on my monitor will completely interrupt me. It just pulls me into a totally new idea before I can even finish typing the line of code I was working on. So, yes, sounds and sights are constantly derailing me right now.
Have you noticed that you’ve lost interest in things you used to enjoy, or that you don’t get as much pleasure out of activities as you used to?

No, not really. Honestly, it's kind of the opposite right now. I'm actually interested in everything. I'm getting so much pleasure out of all these new ideas and projects. I don't feel like I've lost interest in anything at all, I just have too many things I want to do all at once.

Have you had a period of time, lasting at least a week, where your mood was consistently elevated, overly confident, or irritable to the point where it was noticeably different from your usual self, even outside of work or daily responsibilities?

Yeah, definitely. It's been going on for well over a week now. Most days I just feel... lit up, you know? Like I'm completely unstoppable. It really feels like Glendale has finally caught up with what I've been building all this time. 

But, I guess I have been pretty irritable, too. I find myself snapping hard at my wife, or my coworkers, whenever they try to slow me down. They keep bringing up what they call 'process' or wanting to take things step-by-step, and I just... I don't have the patience for it right now. I just want to keep moving.
Have these mood changes, like feeling elevated or irritable, caused any significant problems in your relationships or work performance lately?

Yeah, they definitely have. At work, they actually put me on leave. I bypassed the usual approval process and just deployed some changes on my own because I knew they were right and I didn't want to wait around. They didn't see it that way, so... now I'm on leave. 

And at home, it's not much better. My wife says things feel really unstable right now. We've been arguing a lot, mostly because she's upset about some money I've been spending on new projects. So, yeah, it's definitely causing some real problems.
